# PACELC Theorem

The PACELC Theorem is an extension of the CAP Theorem. One of the questions that CAP Theorem wasnΓÇÖt able to answer was ΓÇ£what happens when there is no Partition, What Logical Combination then a Distributed System have?ΓÇ£. So to answer this, In addition to Consistency, Availability, and Partition Tolerance it also includes Latency as one of the desired properties of a Distributed System. The acronym PACELC stands for Partitioned, Availability, Consistency Else Latency, Consistency.
